summary: No substantiated blocking defects in the base-to-head synthetic Flask demonstration. Build, all 88 pytest tests, and both Ruff checks pass. The 23 mapped automated cases were collected and exercised; TC-018 remains a bounded manual delivery check and TC-024 requires real-browser/assistive-technology testing, which was not performed. Repository inspection found no deployment workflow or deployment activity in this review; activity outside the available record cannot be certified.

requirement_coverage.evidence: Implementation: sign_in.html:4-30 and static/styles.css:15-28,55-85 render the observed outlined centered card, exact labels/hints, link/button/order and administrator copy. Tests: tests/test_entry_pages.py::test_tc_001_sign_in_card_labels_empty_fields_and_examples and ::test_tc_002_sign_in_visual_and_dom_order assert markup, empty inputs and styling contracts; 88-test gate passed. TC-024 real-browser accessibility remains manual.

Implementation: sign_in.html:27 links to GET /forgot-password in __init__.py:102-104, whose template has a labeled request form and working POST handler at __init__.py:106-125. Tests: tests/test_entry_pages.py::test_tc_003_recovery_link_opens_csrf_ready_accessible_request_form and tests/test_recovery_request.py verify the entry and submission; pytest passed.

Implementation: __init__.py:106-125 validates syntax before lookup and always redirects valid requests to the same neutral page; recovery.py:29-58 keeps account and throttle effects private. Tests: tests/test_issuance.py::test_tc_004_tc_019_matched_owner_absent_parity_and_private_counts (both execution orders, 0/4/5 prior requests, normalized keys), plus tests/test_recovery_request.py parity and invalid/CSRF cases, compare public headers, bodies and destinations; pytest passed.

Implementation: recovery.py:35-58 locks normalized-key rolling-hour accounting, expires timestamps at the 3600-second boundary and suppresses issuance when five remain. Tests: tests/test_issuance.py::test_tc_005_tc_006_first_fifth_sixth_and_exact_hour_boundary and ::test_tc_021_two_simultaneous_clients_compete_for_fifth_slot assert counts, exact boundary and concurrent ceiling; pytest passed.

Implementation: recovery.py:50-58 issues an opaque private link; __init__.py:131-165 presents a form and commits a valid new hash using state.py:70-102. Tests: tests/test_reset_commit.py::test_tc_007_valid_commit_changes_only_owner_hash_and_old_sign_in_fails and tests/test_state.py::test_tc_015_issued_and_redeemed_link_is_isolated_between_apps verify owner-only changes and new credentials; pytest passed.

Implementation: state.py:77-102 checks and sets consumed_at under one lock, and __init__.py:131-165 refuses consumed links. Tests: tests/test_reset_commit.py::test_tc_008_replay_get_and_post_cannot_change_hash and ::test_tc_022_concurrent_redemption_has_exactly_one_winner check sequential and parallel replay, hash, version and notice; pytest passed.

Implementation: recovery.py:55-57 sets expiry at issue plus 30 minutes; __init__.py:131-139 and state.py:83-85 apply strict now < expires_at on GET and at locked POST commit. Tests: tests/test_reset_commit.py::test_tc_009_last_microsecond_before_expiry_commits, ::test_tc_010_expired_post_does_not_commit and ::test_tc_010_valid_get_then_expired_post_rechecks_under_lock check just-before, exact/after and stale-GET cases; pytest passed.

Implementation: state.py:92-95 increments the owner's version in the locked reset transition; __init__.py:76-100 checks version on guarded access and clears stale signed sessions. Tests: tests/test_session_revocation.py::test_tc_011_success_revokes_independent_owner_clients_and_copied_cookie checks two owner clients, the resetter, replayed cookie and unaffected peer; failure/replay tests and pytest passed. Process-local restart/multi-worker limits are documented in README.md.

Implementation: state.py:90-102 appends an owner-directed notice for each locked success, restores state on in-process sink failure, and keeps the notice sink separate from the private link outbox. Tests: tests/test_owner_notice.py::test_tc_012_tc_013_two_fresh_successes_append_one_owner_notice_each and ::test_tc_023_sink_failure_rolls_back_all_effects_and_keeps_sessions cover two successes and failed append; pytest passed.

Implementation: .python-version and pyproject.toml:5-8 target Python 3.12 and Flask; __init__.py uses Flask routes and render_template for Jinja HTML. Tests: tests/test_entry_pages.py::test_tc_014_python_312_flask_renders_request_pages and tests/test_state.py::test_tc_014_factory_uses_flask_jinja_and_aware_injectable_utc_clock ran under uv --python 3.12; build and pytest passed.

Implementation: state.py:52-61,105-118 seeds per-app synthetic accounts and separate in-memory owner_notice_sink and owner_link_outbox, with no external notification dependency. Tests: tests/test_state.py::test_tc_015_synthetic_hashes_and_all_store_members_are_per_app and ::test_tc_015_issued_and_redeemed_link_is_isolated_between_apps assert per-instance separation; pytest passed.

Implementation: tests/test_entry_pages.py, test_issuance.py, test_recovery_request.py, test_reset_commit.py, test_session_revocation.py and test_owner_notice.py contain pytest checks of the sign-in and reset acceptance behaviors. Tests: uv run --locked --python 3.12 pytest -q passed all 88; tests/test_delivery_docs.py::test_tc_016_all_automated_case_references_collect_under_python_312 verifies 23/25 mapped case references exist in collection. TC-018 and TC-024 are expressly manual; DOM-only TC-024 assertions do not constitute a browser accessibility pass.

Implementation: README.md:3-16,92-108 documents synthetic accounts, process-local counters/tokens/versions, non-delivery of notices, restarts, multiple workers and non-production security. Tests: tests/test_delivery_docs.py::test_tc_017_readme_documents_local_setup_and_prototype_limits checks the documented limitations; pytest passed.

Implementation/delivery: base-to-head git diff --name-status and git ls-files .github/workflows show no deployment workflow or deployment configuration; this review ran no deployment commands. Test/manual evidence: bounded TC-018 repository tree/diff inspection, plus .github/futuristic/d40bbe8d-773b-4cba-a51e-cab7ab35cbc4/coding-report.md:55-69 records a previous bounded check. No automated test can prove absence of external deployment; prior command-level execution inspection was policy-blocked, so activities outside the inspected materials remain unverified.
